title: The Fibonacci Sequence
text: The Fibonacci sequence is a series of numbers where each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, typically starting 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 21, and so on. Named after the Italian mathematician Fibonacci, the sequence appears in various natural phenomena, such as the arrangement of leaves, flower petals, and spiral shells, and is closely related to the golden ratio.
